scope: New isolated writer-fence candidate only; historical 446/183/120 and prior 21 quiescence tests were not repeated.
rerun_reason: The first new-suite run exposed a cross-thread registry lifecycle defect in the new candidate. The candidate bytes changed to retain the shared state while waiters exist; the final 11-test run above is the post-fix result. No historical suite was rerun.
validated_properties: Same-thread nested calls reuse one cooperative lease
Other threads wait through the outermost release and fail closed on timeout
Other processes are excluded by the existing publication flock
Forked children discard inherited registry descriptors before acquiring their own lease
Alternate production paths, relative paths and symlink lock targets are rejected
Exception exit releases the lease without deleting the lock file
